questions.prompt_md: *If the team had prepared better, they would have won.* What actually happened?

choices.text: They didn't prepare well and didn't win.

questions.explanation_md: El tercer condicional describe lo contrario de lo que ocurrió: no se prepararon bien y perdieron.

questions.prompt_md: *Her coat is still here. She ___ have left yet.*
questions.explanation_md: La evidencia (el abrigo sigue aquí) lleva a deducir que no puede haberse ido: *can't have left*.

questions.prompt_md: Choose the correct option: *___ the high price, the product sold well.*
questions.explanation_md: *Despite* + sustantivo (*the high price*). *Although* necesitaría una oración (*although the price was high*).

questions.prompt_md: *The minister is said to be considering a new tax.* What does this sentence suggest?

choices.text: The minister has announced a new tax.
People report that the minister may be planning a new tax, but it is not confirmed.
The minister said that the tax is bad.
The new tax has been approved.

questions.explanation_md: *Is said to* atribuye la información a otros: no es una afirmación confirmada.

questions.prompt_md: Which sentence has the same meaning as *Sales fell as a result of the strike*?

choices.text: The strike was caused by low sales.
The strike led to a decrease in sales.
Sales fell, and then there was a strike.

questions.explanation_md: Misma relación causa-efecto (huelga → caída de ventas), reformulada con *led to a decrease*.
